parameters.name: IpamPoolId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the IPAM pool.

> **IpamPoolId** cannot be the instance ID of a shared IPAM pool.

parameters.name: IpamScopeId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the IPAM scope.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:

- If this is the first request or no more results exist, leave this parameter empty.
- If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where IPAM is hosted.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- **VPC**: The resource type is VPC.
- **VSwitch**: The resource type is vSwitch.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance to which the resource belongs.
